name: Shield March
intel: Bulwark leads the convoy. It spawns first — its dome protects everything behind it. Hit it before the column closes.

name: Healed Convoy
intel: Bulwark convoy with Healers embedded. If Bulwark survives long enough, Healers restore its HP. Priority: Bulwark first.

name: Double Column
intel: Bulwark + Shieldbearer combine domes. Guardian breaks the Bulwark — towers must then handle Shieldbearers.

name: Hunter Guard
intel: Hunters follow the convoy to threaten Guardian. Deploy Guardian only after Hunters are neutralised by towers.

name: Shield March Finale
intel: Two Bulwark convoys separated by time. Guardian clears the first — must recharge before the second arrives.
